input: Research scholarships for adult returning students

gold.taskTitle: Research Scholarships for Adult Returning Students
gold.taskDescription: Find scholarship opportunities specifically suited to adult learners returning to higher education.

questions.title: What degree or certificate program are you pursuing?
questions.description: Understand the specific academic program the user is returning to study.

questions.title: What is your target start date for school?
questions.description: Determine the timeline to prioritize scholarships with relevant deadlines.

questions.title: Are you attending full-time or part-time?
questions.description: Clarify enrollment status, as many scholarships have full-time or part-time requirements.

questions.title: What type of institution are you attending or considering?
questions.description: Identify whether the user is looking at a community college, university, trade school, or online program.

questions.title: Do you have a specific financial need amount in mind?
questions.description: Understand whether the user needs full tuition coverage or supplemental funding.

questions.title: Are there any demographics that apply to you specifically?
questions.description: Identify relevant personal characteristics such as being a single parent, veteran, or member of a minority group that may open targeted scholarship opportunities.

questions.title: Have you already applied to or ruled out any scholarships?
questions.description: Avoid duplicating research the user has already done and understand their starting point.
